name: Detachable Plate Heat Exchanger
full_description: The official page describes this product as a heat exchanger assembled from multiple heat exchange plates sealed by gaskets and compressed by clamping bolts. The corner holes form continuous channels that distribute media between alternating plates so that two fluids can flow in counter-current arrangement. The product is presented for central heating, air conditioning, nuclear power, metallurgy, petroleum, chemical industry, shipping, medicine, food, paper, textile, and other process conditions including heating, cooling, evaporation, condensation, sterilization, and waste heat recovery.
advantage: Alternating plate channels enable counter-current heat transfer between two media.
Detachable gasketed construction supports servicing and inspection.
Suitable for multiple process duties including heating, cooling, evaporation, condensation, sterilization, and waste heat recovery.
Officially listed for broad use across central heating, air conditioning, marine, petroleum, chemical, medicine, and food applications.
